item.title: Machine Learning Engineer II - Uber
item.description:
About the Role
Uber One is Uber's flagship membership program, serving more than 50 million members globally across Mobility, Delivery, Grocery, and other Uber experiences. Membership combines savings, benefits, priority experiences, and exclusive offerings while driving engagement, cross-platform adoption, and long-term retention.
As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will build product-focused ML systems for targeting, personalization, offers, and member engagement. Your models will directly influence the Membership experiences consumers see across Uber and Uber Eats.
What You Will Do
* Own targeting and personalization models from problem framing through deployment and monitoring.
* Build treatment-effect and uplift models to estimate incremental impact of Membership interventions.
* Design budget-aware allocation systems for consumer offers under real business constraints.
* Build ranking and sequencing models for Membership messaging across Mobility and Delivery.
* Productionize models in real-time serving paths and large-scale batch pipelines.
* Design and analyze experiments to measure incremental product impact.
* Translate ambiguous Membership growth problems into concrete ML solutions with cross-functional partners.
Basic Qualifications
* 3+ years of experience building and shipping production ML models.
* Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM.
* Strong understanding of SQL and large-scale data processing experience with Spark, Hive, Presto, or similar technologies.
* Experience with experimental design, A/B testing, and measurement of noisy product outcomes.
* Experience working on ML systems from offline development through serving, monitoring, and retraining.
* Experience applying ML to user-facing product or business decisions.
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience applying ML to membership, subscription, growth, or consumer engagement products.
* Experience with uplift modeling, treatment effects, ranking, recommendation, or sequential decision systems.
* Experience with constrained optimization, incentives, promotions, pricing, or offer targeting at consumer scale.
* Strong product mindset with experience translating consumer needs and business constraints into measurable ML outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, or Marketing on complex product decisions.
* Familiarity with subscription metrics including conversion, retention, LTV, cannibalization, and incrementality.

item.title: Creative Intelligence & Aesthetics - Machine Learning Engineer - Apple
item.description:
Summary
Apple Intelligence brings powerful generative models to hundreds of millions of people, on device and in the cloud, with an uncompromising commitment to privacy. Delivering these experiences responsibly takes infrastructure that is as reliable and rigorous as the models it supports. We are looking for people who want to help build it. The Creative Intelligence & Aesthetics team sits at the epicenter of Apple's GenAI infrastructure and safety efforts. We build the platforms, pipelines, and tooling that let researchers and engineers train, evaluate, and safeguard Apple's foundation models at scale. Our work directly shapes how quickly and how safely new GenAI features reach customers. If you're passionate about building ML systems that are correct, scalable, and trustworthy, we would like to hear from you.
Description
You will design, build, and maintain the infrastructure that powers Apple's GenAI model development and safety efforts. This includes scalable pipelines for data processing, large-scale model evaluation, safety and red-teaming workflows, and the tooling that researchers rely on every day. You will partner closely with ML researchers, safety specialists, and product teams to understand their needs and turn them into robust, well-engineered systems. You will be responsible for the reliability, reproducibility, and efficiency of these systems, and you will continuously look for ways to improve them. You should stay up to date with the latest developments in ML infrastructure and generative AI, both in academia and in industry, and be able to apply that knowledge to influence Apple's products.
Minimum Qualifications
* 3+ years of experience building and operating infrastructure for machine learning, such as training, evaluation, data processing, or inference systems. * Strong programming skills in Python, along with experience in software engineering best practices (testing, code review, CI/CD). * Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. * Experience with distributed computing and cloud-native technologies. * Exceptional attention to detail: you take pride in getting things right, and you know that small errors in data, metrics, or pipelines can have outsized consequences. * Self-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion with minimal direction. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication. * Ability to work hands-on in multi-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with large language model training, evaluation, or inference stacks is a plus. * Familiarity with AI safety, responsible AI, or model evaluation methodologies would be a plus. * Experience with workflow orchestration, experiment tracking, or large-scale data pipelines would be a plus. * A background in statistics or experimental design would be a plus. * BS, MS, or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Uber
item.description:
About the Team
The Uber Eats Delivery Search team builds large-scale machine learning systems that help consumers discover relevant merchants, products, and items across Uber Eats.
We are transforming Search through two major initiatives: Search as an LLM (SaaL), evolving traditional retrieval and ranking into an LLM-native Search architecture, and Whole-Page Quality, developing AI-powered evaluation and diagnostic capabilities to systematically identify customer-facing defects and improve end-to-end Search experiences.
Our team tackles challenging ML problems spanning large language model training and optimization (CPT, SFT, RL), semantic retrieval, generative Search, model evaluation, and production ML systems at Uber scale.
Role & Responsibilities
As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Delivery Search team, you will design, develop, and deploy ML solutions that power next-generation Search experiences. Specifically, you will:
* LLM Training & Optimization: Develop, train, and optimize large language models for Search using continued pretraining (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and advanced model optimization techniques.
* Search Relevance & Semantic Understanding: Build and improve ML models for semantic retrieval, ranking, and catalog understanding to deliver relevant, personalized, and context-aware Search results across diverse markets and merchant catalogs.
* Whole-Page Quality & Evaluation: Develop LLM-based quality judges, automated evaluation frameworks, and defect detection models to assess end-to-end Search experiences, identify recurring quality issues, and drive measurable improvements.
* ML Experimentation & Production Systems: Design scalable model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines; conduct offline and online experiments; and deploy and monitor ML models in production.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Independently drive complex ML projects from design through production, partnering with ML Infrastructure, Backend Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to deliver measurable customer impact.
Basic Qualifications
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development and deployment of production ML systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Solid foundation in machine learning, deep learning, algorithms, and scalable software engineering.
* Experience developing, training, and evaluating ML models using large-scale datasets.
* Proven ability to independently deliver ML solutions from problem formulation and experimentation through production deployment.
* Experience with model evaluation, performance analysis, and offline or online experimentation.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with large language models, generative AI, and training techniques such as CPT, SFT, or RL.
* Experience with large-scale Search, recommendation, information retrieval, or ranking systems.
* Familiarity with LLM-based evaluation, automated quality assessment, or defect detection.
* Experience with distributed ML training, inference optimization, or production ML infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across engineering teams, lead technical projects, and mentor other engineers.

item.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, YouTube Live Discovery - Youtube
item.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. * Experience developing recommender/ranking/prediction systems for personalized content delivery. * Experience in building and architecting ML systems and infrastructure (e.g., for model training, evaluation, deployment, serving). * Experience working with consumer-facing video, audio or streaming platforms.
### **Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience in building and deploying recommendation systems models (retrieval, prediction, ranking, personalization, search quality, embedding) in production. * Experience in distributed Machine Learning and Machine Learning infrastructure, distributed systems and with Machine Learning algorithms at scale. * Experience in designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. * Experience in Machine Learning model development and deployment frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Tensorflow, Jax, Ray), AI accelerators (e.g., TPUs, GPUs), model architectures (e.g., encoders, decoders, transformers), or APIs. * Experience in search and information retrieval.
**About the job** -----------------
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
As a (TL) Technical Lead, you will work on improving Machine Learning (ML) algorithms and end-to-end solutions to empower live recommendations and grow live ecosystems responsibly. You will set up growth metrics and goals, conduct analysis and research to identify growth areas, and lead a team of engineers to iterate experiments toward launch.
Additionally, you will communicate across YouTube engineering teams and leads, to align with the design direction and future plans of your projects. In this position, you will work with YouTube Discovery teams (e.g., Home, Shorts, WatchNext, Notifications, Living Room), Live Infrastructure, and Live Experience teams, and collaborate with Google DeepMind, YouTube Knowledge, and YouTube Trust and Safety (TnS) teams.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Small Molecule Drug Discovery, AI for Drug Discovery - Genentech
item.description:
### **The Position**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.
**The Opportunity**
Build computational methods and workflows that help scientists discover new medicines. Join the small molecule team within Roche/Genentech’s AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD) organization, formerly Prescient Design, to turn advances in cheminformatics, computational chemistry and machine learning into powerful tools for molecular design. Working alongside world-class drug hunters, you will develop, deploy, and support computational methods used in real discovery programs. With access to extensive scientific data, computational resources and drug discovery expertise, you will shape new capabilities and take them from first prototype to everyday use by scientists and AI agents.
**In this role, you will:**
* Develop computational methods and robust, reusable libraries, APIs, and services for small-molecule drug discovery, spanning cheminformatics, molecular modeling, and property prediction. * Partner with medicinal and computational chemists to identify scientific bottlenecks, design practical implementations, and benchmark and validate in drug discovery campaigns. * Own capabilities from prototype through deployment and ongoing use, collaborating with engineering teams to deliver scalable and reliable workflows on cloud and HPC infrastructure. * Shape the team’s technical direction by proposing new computational approaches and raising software quality. * Share scientific and software contributions through publications, open-source tools and presentations at top conferences.
**Who you are**
* PhD with 0–3 years of relevant experience, or BS/MS with 5+ years of relevant industry experience, in computer science, software engineering, computational chemistry, chemical engineering, or a related quantitative or scientific field such as statistics or physics. * Strong Python programming and software engineering skills, including software design, debugging and performance optimization, with experience in code review, automated testing, packaging, documentation and continuous integration. * Experience developing cheminformatics or computational chemistry workflows using tools such as RDKit, OpenEye or comparable libraries, grounded in an understanding of chemistry and small molecule drug discovery. * Working knowledge of foundational machine learning concepts and experience integrating, deploying, and troubleshooting trained models built with modern ML frameworks. * Strong command of agent-assisted software development using tools such as Codex or Claude Code, and sound practices for reviewing, testing, and maintaining the resulting code. * Evidence of strong technical or scientific contributions through impactful software, open-source contributions, research publications, or other substantial projects.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure supporting scientific software, including Linux, Docker, AWS, and Kubernetes, with the ability to deploy and monitor workloads and troubleshoot application and infrastructure issues.

item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Conversational AI - Services Special Projects - Apple
item.description:
Summary
At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We're building a massive, real-time conversational experience from the ground up, one that will reach users at Apple scale. It sits at the intersection of Generative AI, Information Retrieval, and Knowledge Graphs. We're looking for a senior machine learning engineer to own the conversational intelligence layer: the agent's reasoning and tool-calling, the low-latency LLM inference behind it, and the knowledge services that keep every response accurate and grounded. You'll partner closely with teams across Apple to bring it to production.
Description
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who has shipped conversational AI and LLM systems to production and cares about latency as much as model quality. You'll work closely with AI/ML scientists and engineers across the stack. You'll design multi-turn conversational experiences, build agent logic that plans and calls tools, and develop query understanding models that turn natural language into structured intent. You'll also make large and small models fast and cost-efficient enough to serve in real time. Just as importantly, you'll help make sure every response is accurate and grounded. You'll build and scale knowledge graph services that resolve, enrich, and expand user requests with low latency and also connect the system to real-time data sources so its answers stay current. Finally, you'll build the evaluation that keeps all of it honest: automated and LLM-as-judge evaluation for multi-turn conversations, built into the development workflow so regressions are caught before they reach users.

item.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Retrieval - Reddit, Inc.
item.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.
**Team Description:** The Ads Retrieval ML team builds the machine learning systems that identify relevant advertising candidates for Reddit users. Retrieval sits at the heart of the ads delivery funnel: before downstream ranking and auction decisions, our models determine which campaigns and ads are eligible to compete. We work on large-scale retrieval across multiple objectives, placements, and geographies. Our work combines representation learning, candidate generation, nearest-neighbor search, behavioral and contextual signals, and rigorous offline and online experimentation.
**Role Description:** We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Retrieval ML team. You will lead the design and evolution of retrieval models and modeling practices that improve relevance, advertiser outcomes, and user experience at Reddit scale. This is an applied ML role centered on retrieval modeling and end-to-end product impact. You will be expected to stay close to the technical details—from data and objective design through model development, evaluation, experimentation, and launch—while setting direction for other engineers.
**Responsibilities:**
* Define the technical direction and multi-year roadmap for ads retrieval modeling in partnership with engineering, product, data science, and ads stakeholders. * Design, develop, and launch candidate-generation and retrieval models for campaigns and ads across Reddit's advertising surfaces. * Apply modern approaches such as two-tower architectures, representation learning, embeddings, sequence models, graph-based methods, and other deep learning techniques when they create meaningful product value. * Improve the retrieval stack across key modeling decisions, including objectives, labels, sampling strategies, hard-negative mining, feature design, embedding generation, candidate filtering, and retrieval depth. * Work with approximate nearest-neighbor and vector retrieval systems, reasoning about recall, relevance, freshness, diversity, coverage, latency, and cost trade-offs. * Establish strong evaluation practices that connect retrieval metrics—such as recall, precision, candidate coverage, calibration, and downstream lift—to ads and user outcomes. * Lead offline analysis and online experiments, interpret ambiguous results, and translate findings into the next modeling iteration. * Partner with downstream ranking, ads platform, auction, measurement, and product teams to ensure retrieval models integrate effectively into the full ads funnel. * Write design documents, review code and model changes, and raise the quality bar for modeling, testing, observability, and production ownership. * Mentor ML engineers and help grow the team's expertise in retrieval, recommendation, and representation learning.

**About The Team** DoorDash is building the next generation of causal decisioning systems for New Verticals: grocery, convenience, retail, alcohol, pets, flowers, and other emerging categories. These businesses operate in high-dimensional, dynamic marketplaces where every consumer, merchant, item, promotion, substitution, search result, and delivery promise creates a causal question.
We are hiring a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead the Causal ML pod and establish the technical foundation for company-level causal decisioning. This is a senior technical leadership role for a practitioner who has built consequential causal systems in production and can turn ambiguous business questions into a coherent measurement and decision platform.
A central mandate is to define and build a durable company-level causal value metric: a trusted, long-term signal that estimates the incremental value created by product, growth, and marketplace actions. The metric will connect experiments, observational evidence, and production ML so leaders and product teams can compare investments on a common basis while protecting customer experience and marketplace health.
**About The Role** You will set the multi-year technical direction for causal ML, lead the pod’s portfolio and operating model, and remain close to the hardest modeling and systems work. You will be accountable for both scientific credibility and production impact.
**You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…**
* Lead the Causal ML pod across technical strategy, architecture, execution, and quality. Create a roadmap that joins foundational platform work with high-value product applications. * Define the company-level causal value metric and its measurement framework, including the target construct, time horizon, component outcomes, identification strategy, calibration, uncertainty, and guardrails. * Build the metric into a decision system that teams can use for product prioritization, experiment readouts, intervention selection, budget allocation, and portfolio tradeoffs. * Establish how randomized experiments, quasi-experiments, observational estimation, and learned models work together. Make the limits of each source of evidence explicit. * Architect reusable causal capabilities for treatment effect estimation, surrogate validation, counterfactual policy evaluation, sensitivity analysis, and long-term outcome forecasting. * Guide production applications across promotions, lifecycle interventions, ranking, recommendations, search, substitutions, demand shaping, and inventory-aware discovery. * Set standards for validation, monitoring, reproducibility, and governance so causal estimates remain reliable as policies, populations, and marketplace conditions change. * Influence senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Strategy, and business teams by translating complex causal evidence into clear decisions and tradeoffs. * Develop senior engineers and scientists through technical direction, design review, coaching, and a high bar for causal reasoning and engineering craft.
**Example Focus Areas Include**
* Company-level causal value: Create a common, causally grounded measure of the long-term value generated by product and business actions, enabling teams to compare opportunities across surfaces while preserving interpretable components and guardrails; * Consumer action and lifetime value: Estimate which interventions truly grow durable customer value rather than pull demand forward, including promotions, lifecycle nudges, personalization, retention, and reactivation; * Surrogate metrics and faster learning: Develop and validate early indicators that accelerate decisions before long-term outcomes mature, paired with variance reduction, sequential learning, and clear standards for trust; * Counterfactual ranking and decisioning: Build causal layers for recommendations, search, targeting, demand shaping, and marketplace allocation so systems optimize incremental outcomes rather than predictive relevance alone; and * Causal measurement platform: Create shared infrastructure that connects experiments, observational data, policy logs, estimation, calibration, and decision workflows across teams.
**We’re Excited About You Because You Have…**
* Extensive experience (10+ years) in causal inference, econometrics, experimentation, or causal machine learning, with a record of setting technical direction beyond a single team. * Experience leading the design and productionization of causal models, measurement platforms, experimentation systems, or large-scale decision engines. * Deep judgment about randomized experiments, observational methods, surrogate endpoints, and model-based decisioning, including when evidence is insufficient for a decision. * Fluency with methods such as doubly robust estimation, double machine learning, instrumental variables, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, variance reduction, heterogeneous treatment effects, contextual bandits, and off-policy evaluation. * Strong ML engineering and systems ability. item.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Uber
item.description:
**About The Role** Uber Marketplace is at the heart of Uber’s business, with Rider Pricing playing a critical role by setting prices and targeting promotions for Uber riders. Our team’s mission is to drive revenue growth, ridership growth and Uber’s profitability through advanced machine learning and data science. We build reliable, scalable platforms that optimize rider pricing in both real-time and offline systems, including baseline trip pricing and targeted discounts.
The Rider Pricing team is a fast-moving, high-opportunity space where you’ll have the chance to make a significant impact on the business. On this team, your work will affect over 95% of Uber’s mobility business revenue. You’ll take ownership of one key pillar of the rider pricing domain and lead the technical direction for improving our pricing algorithms, optimization algorithms and models. You will work across ML, serving, and optimization system components, and set technical direction for modeling best practices across model building, evaluation and deployment.
In this role, you'll apply advanced machine learning technologies, including deep learning, generative AI for causal modeling, representation learning and personalization, to optimize Uber’s pricing. You will also work with serving infrastructure and product teams to design and evolve the rider pricing systems to support new product and algorithm evolutions and drive Uber’s top-line rider and revenue growth.
**What You’ll Do**
* Lead a group of SWEs and MLEs working on Uber’s rider pricing to develop and implement new machine learning and optimization techniques powering billions of rides around the world, and helping riders achieve their mobility needs. * Improve the performance of models and algorithms powering pricing algorithms and promotion targeting. * Own the problem E2E, including working with cross-functional teams to define the product and/or technical roadmap. * Mentor more junior team members by role modeling ML best practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and drive Uber’s ridership and revenue growth. Help Uber’s end-users by making mobility options accessible and affordable.
**Basic Qualifications**
* Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, with 7+ years of full-time engineering experience. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., C, C++, Java, Python, Go). * Experience with machine learning and optimization algorithms.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, with 2+ years of full-time engineering experience. * Experience solving complex business problems by translating them into machine learning and optimization solutions. * Familiarity with large-scale data systems (e.g., Spark, Hive) and experience building production-ready algorithmic systems. * Strong background in deep learning, generative AI, causal modeling, and reinforcement learning.
